text: This is how the paper shows it. You’d read it, and then you left Nora like this in the yard.
direction: Inspector Reed, a stocky middle-aged London detective. Low measured chest voice, direct and observant, restrained natural English London accent. Compact bass-baritone with chest resonance and a little vocal grain. Short deliberate phrases, firm downward endings, patient silence between questions. Keep pressure quiet; never bark.
